summary:
Implementation plan for custom gallery wallpapers and start screen enhancements in Lumina Browser:
- Android Photo Picker integration (zero broad storage permissions)
- Persistent local wallpaper storage and state management in BrowserViewModel
- Wallpaper settings sheet with custom image thumbnail, blur, and dimming controls
- High-performance AsyncImage rendering with frosted glass and dim overlay
- Unit test coverage with Robolectric and APK compilation
